decisions.reason: Requesting a complete on-page SEO report does not change the underlying image ALT optimization requirement.
The report request does not change the requested webpage content replacement or revision attributes.
The on-page SEO completion report is distinct from the existing Friday weekly work summary, and the source does not alter that reporting schedule or type.
The source concerns an on-page SEO report and does not change the separate off-page backlink quantity or follow-link distribution.
The on-page SEO report request does not affect backlink indexing or confirmation of Google inclusion.
The report request does not modify the selected campaign keywords, keyword count, or mapped page.
The request for an on-page SEO report does not change blog quantity, publication conditions, or delivery obligations.
